notes.title: Free for all. With all existing boss practicers.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, players!
[/p][p]I guess, most of you came here from the just-dodge.online. In this case, there are good news.

First, the game is now free. Forever.
Second, all boss fight trainers (that existed in game and required completion of the main game) are now available straight away.

Thank you for playing the game, hope you'll keep enjoying it in the future!

Regards,
Gretham [/p]

notes.title: Level builder alpha is live!
notes.notes:
Finaly, a very first public version of level editor.
As of now only local save/load is supported. 

Please test and leave any feedback at https://discord.com/invite/GGSJPFnCf8

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.notes:
Few minor fixes.

P.S. Thanks Zeldafan22 for testing!

notes.title: Fixes
notes.notes:
Due to the engine updates the game was scaled up to be x4 (otherwise collision model didn't work).

Please expect bugs and report them in the bug report sections.
Saved replays are not functioning too, I'll fix them soon.
Fixed unbeatable levels on "ultra hard" difficulty, fixed few timings.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes: Fixed goal time for a few levels

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Sporadic bug on beach boss.
- Game completion bug not showing cutscenes properly.
- Old saves conflict.
- Key rebinding bug fixed and overall behavior is improved.

notes.title: Archievements and tracking
notes.notes:
Achievements are finally here! Track your progress, discover hidden goals and more!

Other updates:
[list]
[*] Added a tracker showing how many other players have completed the level.
[*] Revorked beach boss level keys aspect to reduce the anger a little :D
[*] Small update on the other player's ghost's appearance.
[*] Added an indicator to the castle boss spheres.
[*] Tons of large and small bugs fixed.
[/list]
